scope: Before-change independent headless Chromium observations, six screenshots at two PC sizes. Explicit restored boundaries are not completed UI playthroughs. No user browser/tab/profile/save accessed. No source, strategy, SDK, contract, official process or game rules modified.

findings.criticalBeforeSettle: Both sizes show only pending-main/seal/recovery/reserve consequences. No identification of day4 as a critical promise or full twelve-light condition.
findings.salvageWithoutRack: Both sizes show no reserve, can decline; footer only defer/decline. No visible return-to-anvil/rack-and-reopen action or instructions.
findings.opening: Fresh opening states the immediate commission and seals but not the full critical-day/count requirement. Detailed original text and screenshots retained.
